contract.bound_reviewer_continuity: A structurally exact reviewed-head binding or pending reviewer handoff binds the current reviewer label. Automatic provider/lane recovery returns without rewriting that reviewer or its pending handoff.
contract.independent_fallback: Unbound recovery may still select a replacement, but candidate selection and the canonical persistence boundary both require a reviewer identity independent from the owner.
contract.identity_equivalence: Codex, Codex2, and their canonical Codex lane aliases resolve to one ChatGPT review identity even though their dispatch labels differ.
contract.approval_gate: assign, approve, and merged-done reconciliation reject owner/reviewer pairs whose review identities are equivalent.
contract.merge_gate: The review-before-merge contract treats equivalent identities as no independent reviewer, so neither merge nor auto-merge becomes authorized even if an exact-head approval record is forged for the alternate label.
contract.persistence_gate: Supervisor reassignment persistence refuses any non-independent owner/reviewer pair, covering automatic and chair-driven callers at the canonical write boundary.

no_out_of_scope_runtime_or_v3_change.detail: No .orchestrator/config.json, runtime-state JSON, retry/provider settings, deployment files, product tasks, or V3 generation/decoder fields changed.
